create_OrchestratorRenderer: create an OrchestratorRenderer instance with a SceneReferenceImage to initialize a visual overlay canvas
render_overlay_with_scene_objects: load scene objects from a work unit and render visual overlays onto an image
add_single_overlay_object: add a single overlay icon like DrawCircleIcon or DrawArrowIcon to the renderer object list
reset_all_object_settings: reset all overlay objects, custom thickness, and font size back to default state
get_image_as_bytes: export the rendered overlay image as JPEG or PNG bytes for transmission or storage
